descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S20 「现成的 spec：All Residents 搜索能找到不在今天名单上的住户」 Existing specs: All Residents search finds a resident who is not on today's list

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Search over All Residents can add any resident to today.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 4；TFA-92587 How it works 4）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given A resident with a unique token in the name / unit, not In Today

When Open /snf (not on Today's Visits), switch to All Residents, search partial, case-insensitive with spaces, then a no-match string, then clear

Then Absent from Today's Visits, found by the All Residents search (one result), 'No residents match…' for no match, back after clearing

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in list-controls.spec.ts. This covers the 'search' half of U4 only; adding a search result to today is S02

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；分诊说的是测试问题，现在显示的这个结果是完整通过，状态不改。

问题分类：测试问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92587 ready for qa

医生这边没问题：All Residents 按名字搜索是好的；这条红的是一次被替换掉的旧跑测，列表中途跳回了 Today's Visits。

Nothing is wrong for the physician: All Residents name search works. The red result comes from a superseded harness run in which the list jumped back to Today's Visits mid-test.

依据：The combined report ingested runs/2026-10-14-local/datasets/lists.prev (08:21Z). In that run the 'NAMEWA' search showed 0 cards, and the card did not come back after Clear. The current run (lists/evidence/TC-09-S20.json, 08:30Z) and datasets/results.json have TC-09/S20 passed 8/8. Datasets notes.json calls the 17:10 JST failure a harness false negative (the view re-mounted), fixed in setView/searchField. Lane A (list-controls.spec) passed, and dev U08 (TC-09 S02) passed. The ingest should read lists/, not lists.prev.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev，lane datasets（datasets/results.json，截图不附）。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev/datasets。
